description: Several white paper cups and a few white plastic sip-lids are spread across a small table in front of you. The left hand reaches to lift a small cup while the right hand slides a lid over, presses it down around the rim, then releases; this add-and-press motion is repeated as the hands shift to another cup, briefly holding the cup as a two-hand object while the right hand snaps the lid into place and sets the cup back down.
